It is calculated as true negatives/(true negatives + false positives). Positive predictive value is the proportion of persons with disease who are correctly identified by a screening test as having the disease. It is calculated as true positives/(true positives + false negatives). Prevalence is the proportion of a population that are cases during a specified period of time.
